en: Fixed a damaged response stream showing raw errors such as "JSON Parse error" or "undefined is not an object", or writing the word "undefined" into an answer, instead of being retried or reported as an interrupted response
zh: 修复响应流损坏时显示原始错误（如 "JSON Parse error" 或 "undefined is not an object"），或将 "undefined" 写入回答，而不是重试或报告为响应中断的问题
